components.css: .ds-service-list{font-family:var(--body,'Archivo',sans-serif);color:var(--ink,#23434f);background:var(--wash,#eef1eb);border-top:1px solid #a3b1a6}.ds-service-list details{border-bottom:1px solid #a3b1a6}.ds-service-list summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:27px 0;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-service-list summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-service-list h3{font-family:var(--display,'Tenor Sans',sans-serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(23px,2vw,29px);line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0;text-wrap:balance}.ds-plus{flex-shrink:0;transition:transform .25s ease-out}.ds-service-list details[open] .ds-plus{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-service-list svg{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-service-content{padding:0 45px 27px 0}.ds-service-content p{font-size:17px;max-width:55ch;line-height:1.65;margin:0}.ds-service-content a{color:inherit;display:inline-block;font-size:15px;margin-top:14px;padding-block:8px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-service-content a:hover{text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-service-content a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #61764f;outline-offset:5px}.ds-service-list summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #61764f;outline-offset:5px}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-service-list h3{font-size:24px}.ds-service-list summary{padding-block:23px}.ds-service-content{padding-right:14px}.ds-service-content p{font-size:16px}}@media(max-width:360px){.ds-service-list h3{font-size:22px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-plus{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: Approved November 6 whole-homepage refinement within The Scottsdale Journal: compact rounded courtyard cover, ruled care introduction, copy-led doctor section with original high-resolution portrait and one offset wash backplate, waiting-room service introduction, and reception photo adjoining an ink contact panel. Original logo, navy/sage/white, Tenor Sans/Archivo and verified copy retained. Bryan approved this version and explicitly requested commit/push to update the hosted review preview. Additional pages and production-domain launch remain separate.
keyCharacteristics: Original logo and navy/sage brand identity.
Real practice photography, softly rounded frames and compact captions.
Open display typography, readable body copy, and restrained rules.
Flat surfaces, visible keyboard focus and purposeful reduced-motion-aware photo settling.

rules.name: The Brand Continuity Rule
rules.body: Preserve the original logo and its ink/sage relationship; the supporting neutrals serve the selected identity.

rules.name: The Readable Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep display type for headings and the prominent phone number; use Archivo for navigation, body copy, captions, and ordinary actions.

dos: Do preserve the original logo and the selected navy/sage identity.
Do use actual practice imagery with meaningful alternatives and explicit image dimensions.
Do capitalize the first letter of each word in visible titles, headings, and subheadings while preserving proper names and acronyms.
Do preserve sticky navigation, visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and responsive phone access.
Do keep contact actions honest: use verified phone and contact anchors until scheduling is verified.
donts: Don't replace the chosen photographic journal with repeated cards, shadows or decorative gradients.
Don't add invented reviews, credentials, results, or business facts.
Don't add discounts, specials, coupon copy, or emergency-led hero headlines.
Don't add forms that appear connected without a working destination.
Don't treat direction selection as completed-homepage approval or permission to publish.
